question: What size should the mañcī be on top of the kūṭa-covering?
premises: A mañcī is placed on top of the kūṭa-covering.
The mañcī is assigned a part-measure.
The prescribed measure is seven parts.
inference: The mañcī on top of the kūṭa-covering should be seven parts.
plain_english: The mañcī on top of the kūṭa-covering should be seven parts.
